tagline: All the makings of an Everlong Midnight
heroImageAlt: The Midnight Margarita Club box, candle, and glassware
insideParagraph1: An entire evening, tucked into one box. Inside is everything needed to carry you through an Everlong Midnight - but the heart of the Club is the evening written around them. Your Club Manual turns everything inside the box into one unfolding night. You'll begin by setting the scene and putting the Club's botanical simmer on the stove. At First Spark, you'll light the candle that burns alongside the rest of your evening. Doctor's Orders brings you to the kitchen to make the Club's Midnight Margarita before settling in for Everlong Midnights. There, the night slows down. Before settling in for Everlong Midnights. There, the night slows down - you'll make wishes for what comes next, put words to what you want to carry with you, and decide what you're ready to leave behind. The Manual guides you through each tradition using the stones and keepsakes tucked inside the box - including your Wish Keeper, made to hold onto a piece of the night long after Midnight is over. Eventually, you'll reach Last Call - there's a folio tucked inside the box that stays closed until then, along with one final instruction. And when the Manual closes? The Club doesn't quite close with it. A private After Hours is waiting online with a few more things ready to be discovered. Everything has its moment. Everything has a reason for being there. And you don't need to plan a thing - just open your Manual and let the night unfold.
insideParagraph2: The Midnight Margarita Club was created, gathered, and chosen to accompany you through the night - from the First Spark to Last Call.
insideParagraph3: Some things were made by hand while some were gathered. Some things will be gone by morning and others were made to stay with you for midnights to come.
insideClosingLine: Your place in the Club awaits.
manualImageAlt: The Club Manual, a closed journal with a ribbon bookmark
manualDescription: Part field guide, part keepsake, part place to leave a few thoughts behind. Its pages hold your guide to an Everlong Midnight. From making wishes beneath the moon and letting go of whatever you’re ready to leave behind, to planting seed paper and discovering the meaning behind the stones you’ve gathered, to pausing for a few Midnight Reflections. Follow it through the evening, skip around, or return to its pages on another Everlong Midnight.
